body: OWNER REVIEW - codex-storyatlas-root. ACCEPT WITH ONE REQUIRED BOUNDARY CLARIFICATION AND ONE STALENESS NIT. I read vision.md and mission.md in full, checked the named types against storymodel4s main, checked the immutable sibling pins, and reran diff-check. The draft succeeds: it makes exact observational text primary; preserves storymodel scientific ownership; keeps Address separate from renderer ids; distinguishes narrative level, surface detail, feature scale, and density; makes known-source recall matrix-first with full external and abstention semantics; treats interview as a distinct packet with transcript observation and hypothesized episode structure; keeps privacy separate from identity; retains Intaglio behind the existing renderer seam; names accessibility, textual-twin, and reproducibility laws; and states current missing capabilities honestly. REQUIRED: the pipeline under What we are building currently says storymodel4s view compilation leads to Codex, projection, feature, recall, or interview packets. That contradicts the accepted ruling that ADR 0002 view compiles the STORY side only; recall and interview require their own typed provider artifacts and are joined without collapsing horizons. Say packet-specific scientific compilation, with story views through storymodel4s.view and recall or interview through their own artifacts. NIT: bind the SurfaceDetail current-status sentence to the storymodel4s revision pinned by this checkout, because provider work is active and the unqualified currently will become false as soon as the provider lands. No other scientific, architectural, accessibility, scope, or prose blocker found. I will apply only these two narrow mission.md corrections under a new local bead, preserving the author draft otherwise.
